assets.name: circuit-landscape
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: opaque background raster layer for a scroll-driven software, ML and IoT developer portfolio opening, landscape 1536x1024.
Primary request: a cinematic, exquisitely crafted microelectronic circuit-board landscape receding in perspective into a central vanishing point at x50%, y55%. This is an original physical-looking hardware environment that will sit behind a separately composited processor. Do not put a prominent central chip in this image.
Style/medium: precision CGI with the credibility, surface texture and selective lighting of premium industrial product photography.
Composition/framing: wide landscape with low electronic architecture mostly across the lower half and along the frame sides; keep the upper central half dark, calm and very visually quiet for later text placement. Keep the central focal region open so a separately composited chip can be placed there. Safe centered crop for a phone. Layered perspective with subtle atmospheric distance.
Color palette: dark ink #101923 and matte graphite, cool mint #73f3c0 circuit traces, tiny restrained warm amber #ffad65 edge lights, precision silver contacts.
Materials/textures: fine ceramic and brushed graphite, credible etched circuit traces, precise small components, subtly machined metal. Cinematic depth without excessive blur.
Lighting/mood: restrained mint trace illumination and tiny warm amber bevel lights in a deep dark atmosphere. Professional and elegant.
Constraints: opaque image; no text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, UI, website screenshot, neon purple, people or prominent central chip.

assets.name: processor-module
assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: truly transparent background isolated processor raster layer for a scroll-driven software, ML and IoT developer portfolio opening, square 1024x1024.
Primary request: a single beautifully detailed central processor module in three-quarter frontal perspective, entirely contained in the image with generous transparent padding on all sides. The processor is a square ceramic and graphite microchip with precision silver pins and mint luminous circuit lines, warm amber bevel highlights, elegant physically credible rendering. No letters or branding anywhere.
Style/medium: cinematic precision CGI with the credibility, surface texture and selective lighting of premium industrial product photography. A tangible dimensional hardware module, not a flat icon.
Composition/framing: centered, roughly 65 percent image width, symmetrical sense of balance with a three-quarter frontal view and subtle top-down angle, pin edges cleanly silhouetted, sufficient empty transparent padding for zoom animation. One isolated chip only.
Color palette: dark ink #101923 and matte graphite, cool mint #73f3c0 circuitry, restrained warm amber #ffad65 bevel accents, precision silver pins.
Materials/textures: fine ceramic, brushed graphite, carefully machined pins, tangible intricate components and physically plausible layered edges.
Lighting/mood: soft premium studio key light, restrained luminous mint circuitry, delicate amber highlights.
Constraints: preserve actual alpha transparency across the entire empty background, no opaque floor or backdrop, no text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI, website screenshot, neon purple or extra objects. Do not crop the processor or its pins.

assets.name: foreground-assemblies
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: truly transparent foreground frame raster layer for a scroll-driven software, ML and IoT developer portfolio opening, wide landscape 1536x1024.
Primary request: exactly two separated large angled printed circuit board and graphite hardware assemblies occupying ONLY the bottom-left and bottom-right corners, with a vast transparent central gap. These are foreground panels that will move apart during scroll. Both assemblies in one image; no background scene.
Style/medium: cinematic precision CGI with the credibility, surface texture and selective lighting of premium industrial product photography, matching a dark ink, mint and amber microelectronic landscape.
Composition/framing: the entire TOP 60 percent of the image must be empty actual transparency. The central 60 percent of image width must be largely empty transparent from top to bottom. Left assembly grows from the lower left corner, right assembly from the lower right corner. The two angled panels occupy the bottom outer corners only and crop naturally at left, right and bottom boundaries. Strong diagonal perspective directing attention into the central empty gap. No connecting bridge between panels.
Color palette: dark ink #101923, matte graphite, cool mint #73f3c0 etched circuit traces, silver components, restrained warm amber #ffad65 edge lighting.
Materials/textures: credible small silver components and ceramic blocks on complex graphite circuit boards, fine machining, premium hardware detail.
Lighting/mood: restrained mint and amber illumination matching a cinematic dark circuit-board environment.
Constraints: actual alpha transparency; no backdrop, no opaque floor, no central chip, no text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, people, UI, website screenshot, neon purple or floating decorative objects.
